summary: The Gateway now reuses the projected reply after a prose directive or marker settles and appends text directly when Markdown ownership can safely be reused.
reasoning: I checked the original incremental projector in #158489 and its parent: the parent already parsed the full changed buffer, and the new projector retained that work after a prose marker. The fix PR measured substantially fewer transform calls with byte-identical streamed and final text, and its Gateway timings did not establish a user-visible slowdown.
